question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Orders placed by 2 pm on a working day leave our warehouse the same day. Delivery within Serbia takes 1–3 working days.

question: How much does shipping cost?
answer: Shipping within Serbia costs 390 RSD. It's free for orders over 5,000 RSD.

question: Do you ship outside Serbia?
answer: Yes, we ship to Montenegro, Bosnia and Herzegovina and North Macedonia. Delivery takes 4–7 working days and costs 1,200 RSD; customs fees, if any, are paid on delivery.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: When your parcel leaves us you get an email with a tracking number and a link to the courier's site. You can also ask me: type "Track my order" and have your order number and email ready.

question: Can I change or cancel my order?
answer: Yes, within 2 hours of ordering, before it ships. Ask for a person in this chat with your order number and we'll change or cancel it.

question: How long do I have to return an item?
answer: You can return unworn items with their tags within 14 days of delivery.

question: How do I return something?
answer: Fill in the return form included in your parcel, pack the items in their original packaging and book a free pickup through the link in your order email. The courier collects it from your address.

question: When will I get my money back?
answer: We refund within 5 working days of receiving your return, to the card you paid with or to your bank account for cash-on-delivery orders.

question: Can I exchange an item for a different size?
answer: Yes. Exchanges for another size are free once per order. Note the size you want on the return form and we send it as soon as your return arrives.

question: Can I return items bought on sale?
answer: Yes, sale items follow the same 14-day return policy. Only items marked "final sale" can't be returned.

question: How do I find my clothing size?
answer: Every product page has a size chart in centimetres. Measure your chest, waist and hips and pick the size that matches; if you're between two sizes, take the larger one.

question: Do your shoes run true to size?
answer: Our shoes use EU sizes and fit true to size. Leather loafers are snug at first and stretch slightly; if you have wide feet, go half a size up.

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: You can pay by card (Visa, Mastercard, DinaCard), by bank transfer, or in cash on delivery.

question: Is there a fee for cash on delivery?
answer: No, paying in cash on delivery costs nothing extra.

question: Is it safe to pay by card on your website?
answer: Yes. Card payments go through our bank's secure 3-D Secure page; we never see or store your card details.

question: Do you sell gift cards?
answer: Yes, digital gift cards of 2,000, 5,000 and 10,000 RSD. They arrive by email and are valid for 12 months.

question: How do I use a discount code?
answer: Enter the code in the "Discount code" field at checkout before paying. One code per order; codes don't apply to gift cards.

question: What are your store opening hours?
answer: Our Belgrade store is open Monday to Saturday from 10 am to 8 pm. It's closed on Sundays and public holidays.

question: Where is your physical store?
answer: Our store is at Kralja Petra 21 in central Belgrade, a two-minute walk from Knez Mihailova street.

question: How can I contact customer service?
answer: Ask for a person right here in the chat, or email podrska@kroj.example. We reply on working days from 9 am to 5 pm.

question: How do I care for leather shoes?
answer: Wipe them with a damp cloth, let them dry away from heaters and use a neutral leather cream once a month. Shoe trees help them keep their shape.

question: How should I wash wool sweaters?
answer: Hand wash in cold water with wool detergent, or use your machine's wool cycle at 30 °C. Dry flat; never tumble dry.

question: Where are your clothes made?
answer: Most of our collection is sewn in small workshops in Serbia from European fabrics. Each product page lists the material and country of origin.

question: Will a sold-out item come back in stock?
answer: Many items do. Click "Notify me" on the product page and we'll email you once your size is back.

question: What if my item arrives damaged or wrong?
answer: Sorry about that! Send us a photo within 3 days of delivery by asking for a person in this chat. We'll replace it or refund you, and the return shipping is on us.

question: Koliko traje dostava?
answer: Porudžbine primljene do 14h radnim danom šaljemo istog dana. Dostava u Srbiji traje 1–3 radna dana.

question: Koliko košta dostava?
answer: Dostava u Srbiji košta 390 dinara. Za porudžbine preko 5.000 dinara je besplatna.

question: Da li šaljete van Srbije?
answer: Da, šaljemo u Crnu Goru, Bosnu i Hercegovinu i Severnu Makedoniju. Dostava traje 4–7 radnih dana i košta 1.200 dinara; eventualne carinske troškove plaćaš pri preuzimanju.

question: Kako da pratim svoju porudžbinu?
answer: Kada paket krene, stiže ti mejl sa brojem za praćenje i linkom ka sajtu kurirske službe. Možeš pitati i mene: napiši "Prati porudžbinu" i pripremi broj porudžbine i mejl.

question: Mogu li da izmenim ili otkažem porudžbinu?
answer: Da, u roku od 2 sata od poručivanja, pre slanja. Zatraži osobu u ovom četu i navedi broj porudžbine, pa ćemo je izmeniti ili otkazati.

question: Koji je rok za povraćaj robe?
answer: Nenošene artikle sa etiketama možeš vratiti u roku od 14 dana od dostave.

question: Kako da vratim artikal?
answer: Popuni obrazac za povraćaj iz paketa, spakuj artikle u originalno pakovanje i zakaži besplatno preuzimanje preko linka iz mejla o porudžbini. Kurir ga preuzima sa tvoje adrese.

question: Kada ću dobiti novac nazad?
answer: Novac vraćamo u roku od 5 radnih dana od prijema povraćaja, na karticu kojom je plaćeno ili na tvoj račun za porudžbine plaćene pouzećem.

question: Mogu li da zamenim artikal za drugu veličinu?
answer: Da. Zamena za drugu veličinu je besplatna jednom po porudžbini. Upiši željenu veličinu u obrazac za povraćaj i šaljemo je čim tvoj paket stigne.

question: Da li mogu da vratim artikle sa sniženja?
answer: Da, za artikle sa sniženja važi isti rok od 14 dana. Ne mogu se vratiti samo artikli označeni kao "konačna prodaja".

question: Kako da odredim svoju veličinu odeće?
answer: Na svakoj stranici proizvoda je tabela veličina u centimetrima. Izmeri obim grudi, struka i kukova i izaberi odgovarajuću veličinu; ako si između dve, uzmi veću.

question: Da li vaše cipele odgovaraju standardnim brojevima?
answer: Naše cipele su u EU brojevima i odgovaraju standardnoj veličini. Kožne mokasine su u početku tesne pa se malo rašire; ako imaš široko stopalo, uzmi pola broja veće.

question: Koje načine plaćanja prihvatate?
answer: Možeš platiti karticom (Visa, Mastercard, DinaCard), uplatom na račun ili gotovinom pouzećem.

question: Da li se plaća dodatno za plaćanje pouzećem?
answer: Ne, plaćanje pouzećem ne košta ništa dodatno.

question: Da li je bezbedno platiti karticom na vašem sajtu?
answer: Da. Plaćanje karticom ide preko zaštićene 3-D Secure stranice naše banke; mi nikada ne vidimo niti čuvamo podatke o kartici.

question: Da li prodajete poklon kartice?
answer: Da, digitalne poklon kartice od 2.000, 5.000 i 10.000 dinara. Stižu mejlom i važe 12 meseci.

question: Kako da iskoristim kod za popust?
answer: Unesi kod u polje "Kod za popust" pri plaćanju. Jedan kod po porudžbini; kodovi ne važe za poklon kartice.

question: Koje je radno vreme prodavnice?
answer: Naša prodavnica u Beogradu radi od ponedeljka do subote od 10 do 20h. Nedeljom i praznikom ne radi.

question: Gde se nalazi vaša prodavnica?
answer: Prodavnica je u Ulici kralja Petra 21 u centru Beograda, dva minuta hoda od Knez Mihailove.

question: Kako da kontaktiram korisničku podršku?
answer: Zatraži osobu ovde u četu ili piši na podrska@kroj.example. Odgovaramo radnim danima od 9 do 17h.

question: Kako da održavam kožne cipele?
answer: Obriši ih vlažnom krpom, osuši dalje od grejanja i jednom mesečno nanesi neutralnu kremu za kožu. Kalupi za cipele pomažu da zadrže oblik.

question: Kako da perem vunene džempere?
answer: Peri ručno u hladnoj vodi sa deterdžentom za vunu ili na programu za vunu na 30 °C. Suši ravno položeno; nikako u mašini za sušenje.

question: Gde se proizvodi vaša odeća?
answer: Većina kolekcije se šije u malim radionicama u Srbiji od evropskih materijala. Na svakoj stranici proizvoda piše materijal i zemlja porekla.

question: Da li će rasprodat artikal ponovo biti dostupan?
answer: Mnogi hoće. Klikni "Obavesti me" na stranici proizvoda i javićemo ti mejlom kada tvoja veličina ponovo stigne.

question: Šta ako stigne oštećen ili pogrešan artikal?
answer: Izvini zbog toga! Pošalji nam fotografiju u roku od 3 dana od dostave tako što ćeš zatražiti osobu u ovom četu. Zamenićemo artikal ili vratiti novac, a troškove povraćaja snosimo mi.
